name: nexus-factory
description: Connects Claude Code or Claude Desktop on the factory machine to the Nexus factory app through the factory's own local server (stdio, no network), and adds the factory-desk skill. Claude reads orders, quotes, production, materials, shipments, the inbox and, with permission, the money; with a drafting token it can also make drafts: DRAFT quotes and purchase orders, internal comments, and one work-order stage step. Sending, converting, labels, invoices and payments stay in the factory app.

repo_dir.title: Nexus repository folder
repo_dir.description: The top folder of the copy of the Nexus repository the factory app runs from on this machine (its dependencies installed with npm ci).

factory_token.title: Factory token for Claude
factory_token.description: The token the factory app shows once in Settings › Integrations › Claude. Kept in this computer's secure storage, never in a file.
